headline: Executive order keeps a White House council and advisory board on American workers and job training in operation.
what_it_does: This order continues two existing groups: the President's National Council for the American Worker and the American Workforce Policy Advisory Board. Based on the title, it keeps them running rather than letting them end. No summary was provided, so details such as how long they continue or any changes to their duties are not clear.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the National Council for the American Worker and the American Workforce Policy Advisory Board
who_it_affects.how: They can keep meeting and working because their groups are continued.
